blocks.title: After this PDF you can
bullets: use the Germanic roots Dutch and English share to guess words
recognise French loanwords and their pronunciation
conjugate English verbs in Dutch (downloaden → gedownload)
know which English words come from Dutch

blocks.text: Dutch and English are close relatives: both are West Germanic languages. Many basic words share a root, often with regular sound changes. Knowing them helps you guess new words.

From the Middle Ages to the 19th century, French was the language of culture and the elite. Thousands of French words entered Dutch, often keeping a French spelling and pronunciation (stress on the last syllable).

Today English is the main source of new words: laptop, meeting, deadline, weekend, cool. English verbs get Dutch endings and follow Dutch rules, with 't kofschip judged by the sound of the English stem: downloaden → ik download, gedownload; updaten → geüpdatet; chillen → gechilld.

blocks.title: geüpdatet: odd, but correct
blocks.text: The stem of updaten is updat, pronounced with a t, so the participle ends in -t with an -e- in between: geüpdatet. The trema shows that ge and up are separate syllables. These forms look strange, but they follow the official spelling.

blocks.title: From Dutch into English
items: to snoop (originally: to eat sweets secretly)

blocks.title: From the sea and New Amsterdam
blocks.text: Many of these words come from the 17th century, when the Dutch led in shipping (yacht, skipper, deck) and painting (landscape, easel, sketch). Cookie, boss and Santa Claus came into American English through New Amsterdam, today's New York.
Fill in the missing word. The answers are on the last page.

items.q: Neem je ______ mee, het gaat regenen.
items.full: Neem je paraplu mee, het gaat regenen.

items.q: Ik heb een ______ voor je verjaardag.
items.full: Ik heb een cadeau voor je verjaardag.
Mijn portemonnee zit in mijn jaszak.

items.q: Wat is je ______ Nederlands? B2 of C1?
items.full: Wat is je niveau Nederlands? B2 of C1?

items.q: Het Engelse woord yacht komt van het Nederlandse woord ______.
items.full: Het Engelse woord yacht komt van het Nederlandse woord jacht.

items.q: De schilder zette zijn doek op de ______.
items.full: De schilder zette zijn doek op de ezel.

items.q: Ik heb gisteren de hele dag ______.
items.full: Ik heb gisteren de hele dag gechilld.
